instruction: Use Drone with build parameters for matrix
output: drone build queue owner/repo --param GO_VERSION=1.21 --param NODE_VERSION=20

instruction: Use Woodpecker with environment variable matrix
output: echo 'matrix: NODE: - 18 - 20 GO: - 1.21 - 1.22 pipeline: test: image: golang:${GO} commands: - go test environment: - NODE_VERSION=${NODE}' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker with skip_clone setting
output: echo 'skip_clone: true pipeline: info: image: alpine:latest commands: - echo no clone' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Use Drone pipeline with network_mode
output: echo 'steps: - name: curl image: alpine network_mode: host commands: - curl http://localhost:8080' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone pipeline with DNS settings
output: echo 'steps: - name: dns image: alpine dns: - 8.8.8.8 commands: - nslookup example.com' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone pipeline with CPU count limit
output: echo 'steps: - name: test image: golang cpu: 2 commands: - go test -parallel 2' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone pipeline with memory limit
output: echo 'steps: - name: build image: golang memory: 1024 commands: - go build' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with pipeline user namespace
output: echo 'steps: - name: safe image: alpine user: 1000:1000 commands: - whoami' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with secrets masked in logs
output: echo 'steps: - name: deploy image: alpine secrets: - my_secret commands: - echo $my_secret' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker with masked secrets
output: echo 'pipeline: deploy: image: alpine:latest secrets: - db_password commands: - echo $db_password' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Configure Woodpecker agent for multiple platforms
output: export WOODPECKER_PLATFORM=linux/amd64,linux/arm64 && woodpecker-agent

instruction: Configure Drone runner for specific image whitelist
output: export DRONE_RUNNER_PRIVILEGED_IMAGES=golang:*,node:* && export DRONE_RUNNER_LABELS=type:privileged

instruction: Use Drone with build cancellation on PR close
output: drone repo update owner/repo --build-cancel-pull-requests

instruction: Use Woodpecker to list all pipelines in a file
output: woodpecker-cli build ls owner/repo --event push --limit 5

instruction: Use Woodpecker build number in deploy script
output: echo 'pipeline: tag: image: alpine:latest commands: - echo v${CI_PIPELINE_NUMBER}' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Use Drone to deploy with Docker Compose
output: echo 'steps: - name: deploy image: alpine commands: - scp docker-compose.yml deploy@host:~ - ssh deploy@host "docker compose up -d"' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker to deploy via kubectl
output: echo 'pipeline: deploy: image: alpine:latest commands: - kubectl set image deployment/app app=registry.example.com/app:${CI_COMMIT_SHA}' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Use Drone to notify via Matrix (chat)
output: echo 'steps: - name: notify image: plugins/matrix settings: homeserver: matrix.example.com room: '!room:example.com' username: dronebot password: pass' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker with Telegram notification
output: echo 'pipeline: notify: image: appleboy/drone-telegram settings: token: 123:abc to: - chat_id' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Use Drone with custom webhook notification
output: echo 'steps: - name: webhook image: alpine commands: - curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"status": "done"}' https://hooks.example.com/ci' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker with multi-arch Docker build
output: echo 'pipeline: build: image: plugins/docker-buildx settings: platforms: - linux/amd64 - linux/arm64 repo: owner/app tags: latest' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker with Docker layer caching
output: echo 'pipeline: build: image: plugins/docker settings: repo: owner/app cache_from: - owner/app:cache' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker with registry mirror
output: echo 'pipeline: build: image: golang:latest commands: - go build environment: - REGISTRY_MIRROR=http://mirror:5000' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker with step timeout for long builds
output: echo 'pipeline: build: image: golang:latest commands: - go build timeout: 600' > .woodpecker.yml
